audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] said to save Wind Wall for 'her Watch Out! (E) missile poke', and dosFull[2] said to Wind Wall Blooming Blows.
audit.why: Watch Out! Eep! is Lillia's W, not her E, and it is a ground AoE with no projectile. Blooming Blows (Q) is an AoE around her, also not a projectile. Swirlseed (E) is the only ability in her kit with the projectile flag — it is the seed that rolls until it hits a wall or target, and it is the one thing Wind Wall stops.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall answers Swirlseed (E) only; Blooming Blows and Watch Out! Eep! pass through it.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 falling to 4s, Swirlseed is a flat 12s, Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1. Without those numbers 'engage when it is down' is not actionable.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written into dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: The mirror's note describes a chart that is 'Lillia's from 2 through first item' off a 66.67% win rate over 24 games, while this side's packet reads 50.58% over 862 games and every whys[] here says Yasuo owns levels 2 through first item. Flipping five rows on the strength of an ambiguous note would put a claim on the page I cannot verify, so I left the chart untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: No warning that resistances do not answer her damage.
audit.why: Blooming Blows deals extra TRUE damage on its outer edge — stacking armour or MR reads that trade wrong, and the positional answer is to fight inside the ring rather than on its rim.
